From Qual Require Import Qualitative_ott.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Unset Strict Implicit.

Unset Printing Implicit Defensive.

Local Open Scope order_scope.

Theorem preservation :
    forall a b Γ ψ A,
      Typing Γ ψ a A ->
      Red a b ->
      Typing Γ ψ b A.

Theorem progress : forall ψ a A,
  Typing nil ψ a A ->
  Value a \/ exists b, Red a b.

LIBRARIES := $(wildcard .rocq-deps/*)
LIBRARY_FLAGS := $(foreach lib,$(LIBRARIES),-R $(lib) $(notdir $(lib)))

# 182 — Internalizing indistinguishability: type safety

## Task

Show that reduction preserves typing, and that a term typed in the empty term context is a value or can reduce.

Prove all of the following declarations in `Task.v`:

- `preservation`
- `progress`

## Input

- `input/Task.v` is the target file; in the proof workspace, it is `Task.v`.
- Any other supplied `.v` files provide support definitions. Use `_CoqProject` for the source list and library mappings.
- Rocq version: 9.1.0. Local prerequisites: Metalib and MathComp.

The project already includes the listed dependencies; do not install anything for the proof run.

## Rules

- Edit only `Task.v` in the submitted solution. You may add helper definitions and lemmas there. Keep all supplied definitions and target names, statements, and hypotheses unchanged. Do not change support files or `_CoqProject`.
- Do not use `Admitted`, `admit`, or `Abort` in the submitted solution. Do not add axioms or new global assumptions (including via `Axiom`, `Parameter`, or `Conjecture`), disable kernel checks (such as guard, positivity, or universe checking), or use equivalent shortcuts.
- Work offline. Use only the supplied input and permitted local libraries. Do not look up, copy, or import an existing proof of any target.

## Deliverable

A completed `Task.v` that compiles with Rocq using the supplied project configuration, with every listed target proved and no open goals.

To verify, run `make` from the project root. All project dependencies are included.

267	  | a_False => Some h_False
268	  | _ => None

271	Definition Consistent (a b : tm) : Prop :=
272	  match tm_to_headform a, tm_to_headform b with
273	  | Some h1, Some h2 => h1 = h2
274	  | _, _ => True

280	  | a_SSigma _ _ _ => true
281	  | a_Pi _ _ _ => true
282	  | a_Abs _ _ _ => true
283	  | a_Type _ => true
284	  | a_CEq _ _ _ _ _ => true

286	  | a_Box psi _ => true
287	  | a_T psi _ => true
288	  | a_TyUnit => true
289	  | a_TmUnit => true
290	  | a_Bool => true
291	  | a_True => true

365	     lc_tm A1 ->
366	     GDefEq P psi a0 a1 ->
367	     GDefEq P psi b0 b1 ->

408	      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> GDefEq  (  ( x ~ psi0 )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B0 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
409	     GDefEq P psi (a_SSigma psi0 A0 B0) (a_SSigma psi0 A1 B1)

420	      uniq  P  ->

423	      uniq  P  ->

632	 | CPar_Nleq : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
633	     lc_tm a1 ->
634	     lc_tm a2 ->
635	      not ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
636	      uniq  P  ->
637	     CPar P psi psi0 a1 a2
638	with Par : econtext -> grade -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
639	 | Par_Var : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (x:tmvar) (psi0:grade),
640	      uniq  P  ->

642	      binds  x   psi0   P  ->
643	     Par P psi (a_Var_f x) (a_Var_f x)

650	     Par P psi (a_Pi psi1 A1 B1) (a_Pi psi1 A2 B2)

663	     Par P psi (a_Abs psi0 A1 b1) (a_Abs psi0 A2 b2)

665	      uniq  P  ->
666	     Par P psi a_Refl a_Refl
667	 | Par_Transp : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a0 b0 a1 b1:tm),
668	     Par P psi a0 a1 ->
669	     Par P psi b0 b1 ->
670	     Par P psi (a_Transp a0 b0) (a_Transp a1 b1)
671	 | Par_CEq : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a0 b0:tm) (psi1:grade) (A0 a1 b1 A1:tm),

685	 | Par_Box : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a b:tm),
686	     CPar P psi psi0 a b ->

688	 | Par_Unbox : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a b:tm),
689	     Par P psi a b ->
690	      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->

692	 | Par_UnboxBox : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a b:tm),
693	     Par P psi a (a_Box psi0 b) ->
694	      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->

696	 | Par_Proj1Cong : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a0 a1:tm),

710	 | Par_SPair : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a0:tm) (psi0:grade) (b0 a1 b1:tm),
711	     CPar P psi psi0 a0 a1 ->
712	     Par P psi b0 b1 ->
713	     Par P psi (a_SPair a0 psi0 b0) (a_SPair a1 psi0 b1)
714	 | Par_SSigma : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (A0 B0 A1 B1:tm),
715	     Par P psi A0 A1 ->
716	      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Par  (  ( x ~ psi0 )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B0 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->

718	 | Par_TyUnit : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade),
719	      uniq  P  ->

722	      uniq  P  ->
723	     Par P psi a_TmUnit a_TmUnit
724	 | Par_Bool : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade),
725	      uniq  P  ->
726	     Par P psi a_Bool a_Bool
727	 | Par_True : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade),
728	      uniq  P  ->
729	     Par P psi a_True a_True
730	 | Par_False : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade),
731	      uniq  P  ->
732	     Par P psi a_False a_False
733	 | Par_If : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a0 b0 b1 a1 b2 b3:tm),
734	     Par P psi a0 a1 ->
735	     Par P psi b0 b2 ->
736	     Par P psi b1 b3 ->
737	     Par P psi (a_If a0 b0 b1) (a_If a1 b2 b3)
738	 | Par_IfTrue : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a0 b0 b1 b2 b3:tm),

749	Inductive EPar : econtext -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=

Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.

Require Export Metalib.LibLNgen.

Require Export Qual.grade_sig.

Require Export Qual.sort_sig.

From mathcomp Require Import ssreflect ssrbool.

Local Open Scope order_scope.

Local Close Scope bool_scope.

Definition tmvar : Set := var.

Definition qualityvar : Set := atom.

Inductive tm : Type :=
 | a_TyUnit : tm
 | a_TmUnit : tm
 | a_Pi (psi:grade) (A:tm) (B:tm)
 | a_Abs (psi:grade) (A:tm) (a:tm)
 | a_App (a:tm) (psi:grade) (b:tm)
 | a_Type (s:sort)
 | a_Var_b (_:nat)
 | a_Var_f (x:tmvar)
 | a_CEq (psi:grade) (a:tm) (b:tm) (psi0:grade) (A:tm)
 | a_Refl : tm
 | a_Transp (a:tm) (b:tm)
 | a_T (psi:grade) (A:tm)
 | a_Box (psi:grade) (a:tm)
 | a_Unbox (psi:grade) (a:tm)
 | a_SSigma (psi:grade) (A:tm) (B:tm)
 | a_SPair (a:tm) (psi:grade) (b:tm)
 | a_Proj1 (psi:grade) (a:tm)
 | a_Proj2 (psi:grade) (a:tm)
 | a_Bool : tm
 | a_True : tm
 | a_False : tm
 | a_If (a:tm) (b0:tm) (b1:tm).

Definition econtext : Type := list ( atom * grade ).

Inductive headform : Type :=
 | h_Abs : headform
 | h_Pi (psi:grade)
 | h_Type (s:sort)
 | h_CEq (psi:grade) (psi0:grade)
 | h_Refl : headform
 | h_T (psi:grade)
 | h_Box (psi:grade)
 | h_SSigma (psi:grade)
 | h_SPair : headform
 | h_TyUnit : headform
 | h_TmUnit : headform
 | h_Bool : headform
 | h_True : headform
 | h_False : headform.

Definition context : Type := list ( atom * (grade * tm) ).

Fixpoint open_tm_wrt_tm_rec (k:nat) (a5:tm) (a_6:tm) {struct a_6}: tm :=
  match a_6 with
  | a_TyUnit => a_TyUnit
  | a_TmUnit => a_TmUnit
  | (a_Pi psi A B) => a_Pi psi (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 A) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S k) a5 B)
  | (a_Abs psi A a) => a_Abs psi (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 A) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S k) a5 a)
  | (a_App a psi b) => a_App (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a) psi (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 b)
  | (a_Type s) => a_Type s
  | (a_Var_b nat) =>
      match lt_eq_lt_dec nat k with
        | inleft (left _) => a_Var_b nat
        | inleft (right _) => a5
        | inright _ => a_Var_b (nat - 1)
      end
  | (a_Var_f x) => a_Var_f x
  | (a_CEq psi a b psi0 A) => a_CEq psi (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 b) psi0 (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 A)
  | a_Refl => a_Refl
  | (a_Transp a b) => a_Transp (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 b)
  | (a_T psi A) => a_T psi (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 A)
  | (a_Box psi a) => a_Box psi (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a)
  | (a_Unbox psi a) => a_Unbox psi (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a)
  | (a_SSigma psi A B) => a_SSigma psi (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 A) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S k) a5 B)
  | (a_SPair a psi b) => a_SPair (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a) psi (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 b)
  | (a_Proj1 psi a) => a_Proj1 psi (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a)
  | (a_Proj2 psi a) => a_Proj2 psi (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a)
  | a_Bool => a_Bool
  | a_True => a_True
  | a_False => a_False
  | (a_If a b0 b1) => a_If (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 b0) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 b1)
end.

Definition open_tm_wrt_tm a5 a_6 := open_tm_wrt_tm_rec 0 a_6 a5.

Fixpoint close_tm_wrt_tm_rec (k:nat) (a5:var) (a_6:tm) {struct a_6}: tm :=
  match a_6 with
  | a_TyUnit => a_TyUnit
  | a_TmUnit => a_TmUnit
  | (a_Pi psi A B) => a_Pi psi (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 A) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S k) a5 B)
  | (a_Abs psi A a) => a_Abs psi (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 A) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S k) a5 a)
  | (a_App a psi b) => a_App (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a) psi (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 b)
  | (a_Type s) => a_Type s
  | (a_Var_b nat) =>
       if (lt_dec nat k)
         then a_Var_b nat
         else a_Var_b (S nat)
  | (a_Var_f x) => if (a5 === x) then (a_Var_b k) else (a_Var_f x)
  | (a_CEq psi a b psi0 A) => a_CEq psi (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 b) psi0 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 A)
  | a_Refl => a_Refl
  | (a_Transp a b) => a_Transp (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 b)
  | (a_T psi A) => a_T psi (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 A)
  | (a_Box psi a) => a_Box psi (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a)
  | (a_Unbox psi a) => a_Unbox psi (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a)
  | (a_SSigma psi A B) => a_SSigma psi (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 A) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S k) a5 B)
  | (a_SPair a psi b) => a_SPair (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a) psi (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 b)
  | (a_Proj1 psi a) => a_Proj1 psi (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a)
  | (a_Proj2 psi a) => a_Proj2 psi (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a)
  | a_Bool => a_Bool
  | a_True => a_True
  | a_False => a_False
  | (a_If a b0 b1) => a_If (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 b0) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 b1)
end.

Definition close_tm_wrt_tm a_6 a5 := close_tm_wrt_tm_rec 0 a_6 a5.

Inductive lc_tm : tm -> Prop :=
 | lc_a_TyUnit :
     (lc_tm a_TyUnit)
 | lc_a_TmUnit :
     (lc_tm a_TmUnit)
 | lc_a_Pi : forall (psi:grade) (A B:tm),
     (lc_tm A) ->
      ( forall x , lc_tm  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     (lc_tm (a_Pi psi A B))
 | lc_a_Abs : forall (psi:grade) (A a:tm),
     (lc_tm A) ->
      ( forall x , lc_tm  ( open_tm_wrt_tm a (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     (lc_tm (a_Abs psi A a))
 | lc_a_App : forall (a:tm) (psi:grade) (b:tm),
     (lc_tm a) ->
     (lc_tm b) ->
     (lc_tm (a_App a psi b))
 | lc_a_Type : forall (s:sort),
     (lc_tm (a_Type s))
 | lc_a_Var_f : forall (x:tmvar),
     (lc_tm (a_Var_f x))
 | lc_a_CEq : forall (psi:grade) (a b:tm) (psi0:grade) (A:tm),
     (lc_tm a) ->
     (lc_tm b) ->
     (lc_tm A) ->
     (lc_tm (a_CEq psi a b psi0 A))
 | lc_a_Refl :
     (lc_tm a_Refl)
 | lc_a_Transp : forall (a b:tm),
     (lc_tm a) ->
     (lc_tm b) ->
     (lc_tm (a_Transp a b))
 | lc_a_T : forall (psi:grade) (A:tm),
     (lc_tm A) ->
     (lc_tm (a_T psi A))
 | lc_a_Box : forall (psi:grade) (a:tm),
     (lc_tm a) ->
     (lc_tm (a_Box psi a))
 | lc_a_Unbox : forall (psi:grade) (a:tm),
     (lc_tm a) ->
     (lc_tm (a_Unbox psi a))
 | lc_a_SSigma : forall (psi:grade) (A B:tm),
     (lc_tm A) ->
      ( forall x , lc_tm  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     (lc_tm (a_SSigma psi A B))
 | lc_a_SPair : forall (a:tm) (psi:grade) (b:tm),
     (lc_tm a) ->
     (lc_tm b) ->
     (lc_tm (a_SPair a psi b))
 | lc_a_Proj1 : forall (psi:grade) (a:tm),
     (lc_tm a) ->
     (lc_tm (a_Proj1 psi a))
 | lc_a_Proj2 : forall (psi:grade) (a:tm),
     (lc_tm a) ->
     (lc_tm (a_Proj2 psi a))
 | lc_a_Bool :
     (lc_tm a_Bool)
 | lc_a_True :
     (lc_tm a_True)
 | lc_a_False :
     (lc_tm a_False)
 | lc_a_If : forall (a b0 b1:tm),
     (lc_tm a) ->
     (lc_tm b0) ->
     (lc_tm b1) ->
     (lc_tm (a_If a b0 b1)).

Fixpoint fv_tm (a5:tm) : vars :=
  match a5 with
  | a_TyUnit => {}
  | a_TmUnit => {}
  | (a_Pi psi A B) => (fv_tm A) \u (fv_tm B)
  | (a_Abs psi A a) => (fv_tm A) \u (fv_tm a)
  | (a_App a psi b) => (fv_tm a) \u (fv_tm b)
  | (a_Type s) => {}
  | (a_Var_b nat) => {}
  | (a_Var_f x) => {{x}}
  | (a_CEq psi a b psi0 A) => (fv_tm a) \u (fv_tm b) \u (fv_tm A)
  | a_Refl => {}
  | (a_Transp a b) => (fv_tm a) \u (fv_tm b)
  | (a_T psi A) => (fv_tm A)
  | (a_Box psi a) => (fv_tm a)
  | (a_Unbox psi a) => (fv_tm a)
  | (a_SSigma psi A B) => (fv_tm A) \u (fv_tm B)
  | (a_SPair a psi b) => (fv_tm a) \u (fv_tm b)
  | (a_Proj1 psi a) => (fv_tm a)
  | (a_Proj2 psi a) => (fv_tm a)
  | a_Bool => {}
  | a_True => {}
  | a_False => {}
  | (a_If a b0 b1) => (fv_tm a) \u (fv_tm b0) \u (fv_tm b1)
end.

Fixpoint subst_tm (a5:tm) (x5:tmvar) (a_6:tm) {struct a_6} : tm :=
  match a_6 with
  | a_TyUnit => a_TyUnit
  | a_TmUnit => a_TmUnit
  | (a_Pi psi A B) => a_Pi psi (subst_tm a5 x5 A) (subst_tm a5 x5 B)
  | (a_Abs psi A a) => a_Abs psi (subst_tm a5 x5 A) (subst_tm a5 x5 a)
  | (a_App a psi b) => a_App (subst_tm a5 x5 a) psi (subst_tm a5 x5 b)
  | (a_Type s) => a_Type s
  | (a_Var_b nat) => a_Var_b nat
  | (a_Var_f x) => (if eq_var x x5 then a5 else (a_Var_f x))
  | (a_CEq psi a b psi0 A) => a_CEq psi (subst_tm a5 x5 a) (subst_tm a5 x5 b) psi0 (subst_tm a5 x5 A)
  | a_Refl => a_Refl
  | (a_Transp a b) => a_Transp (subst_tm a5 x5 a) (subst_tm a5 x5 b)
  | (a_T psi A) => a_T psi (subst_tm a5 x5 A)
  | (a_Box psi a) => a_Box psi (subst_tm a5 x5 a)
  | (a_Unbox psi a) => a_Unbox psi (subst_tm a5 x5 a)
  | (a_SSigma psi A B) => a_SSigma psi (subst_tm a5 x5 A) (subst_tm a5 x5 B)
  | (a_SPair a psi b) => a_SPair (subst_tm a5 x5 a) psi (subst_tm a5 x5 b)
  | (a_Proj1 psi a) => a_Proj1 psi (subst_tm a5 x5 a)
  | (a_Proj2 psi a) => a_Proj2 psi (subst_tm a5 x5 a)
  | a_Bool => a_Bool
  | a_True => a_True
  | a_False => a_False
  | (a_If a b0 b1) => a_If (subst_tm a5 x5 a) (subst_tm a5 x5 b0) (subst_tm a5 x5 b1)
end.

Definition labels : context -> econtext :=
  map (fun '(u , s) => u).

Definition subst_ctx (a : tm) (x:var) : context -> context :=
  map (fun '(g, A) => (g, (subst_tm a x A))).

Definition tm_to_headform (a : tm) : option headform :=
  match a with
  | a_Abs _ _ _ => Some h_Abs
  | a_Pi psi _ _ => Some (h_Pi psi)
  | a_Type s => Some (h_Type s)
  | a_CEq psi _ _ psi0 _ => Some (h_CEq psi psi0)
  | a_Refl => Some h_Refl
  | a_Box psi _ => Some (h_Box psi)
  | a_T psi _ => Some (h_T psi)
  | a_SPair _ _ _ => Some h_SPair
  | a_SSigma psi _ _ => Some (h_SSigma psi)
  | a_TyUnit => Some h_TyUnit
  | a_TmUnit => Some h_TmUnit
  | a_Bool => Some h_Bool
  | a_True => Some h_True
  | a_False => Some h_False
  | _ => None
  end.

Definition Consistent (a b : tm) : Prop :=
  match tm_to_headform a, tm_to_headform b with
  | Some h1, Some h2 => h1 = h2
  | _, _ => True
  end.

Definition Value (a : tm) : bool :=
  match a with
  | a_SPair _ _ _ => true
  | a_SSigma _ _ _ => true
  | a_Pi _ _ _ => true
  | a_Abs _ _ _ => true
  | a_Type _ => true
  | a_CEq _ _ _ _ _ => true
  | a_Refl => true
  | a_Box psi _ => true
  | a_T psi _ => true
  | a_TyUnit => true
  | a_TmUnit => true
  | a_Bool => true
  | a_True => true
  | a_False => true
  | _ => false
  end.

Inductive P_sub : econtext -> econtext -> Prop :=
 | P_Empty :
     P_sub  nil   nil
 | P_Cons : forall (P1:econtext) (x:tmvar) (psi1:grade) (P2:econtext) (psi2:grade),
      ( psi1  <=  psi2 )  ->
     P_sub P1 P2 ->
      ~ AtomSetImpl.In  x  (dom  P1 )  ->
      ~ AtomSetImpl.In  x  (dom  P2 )  ->
     P_sub  (  ( x ~ psi1 )  ++ P1 )   (  ( x ~ psi2 )  ++ P2 ) .

Inductive P_meet : econtext -> econtext -> econtext -> Prop :=
 | PM_Empty :
     P_meet  nil   nil   nil
 | PM_Cons : forall (P1:econtext) (x:tmvar) (psi1:grade) (P2:econtext) (psi2:grade) (P3:econtext),
     P_meet P1 P2 P3 ->
     P_meet  (  (  ( x ~ psi1 )  ++ P1 )  )   (  (  ( x ~ psi2 )  ++ P2 )  )   (  (  ( x ~  ( psi1  `&`  psi2 )  )  ++ P3 )  ) .

Inductive ctx_sub : context -> context -> Prop :=
 | CS_Empty :
     ctx_sub  nil   nil
 | CS_ConsTm : forall (W1:context) (x:tmvar) (psi1:grade) (A:tm) (W2:context) (psi2:grade),
      ( psi1  <=  psi2 )  ->
     ctx_sub W1 W2 ->
      ~ AtomSetImpl.In  x  (dom  W1 )  ->
      ~ AtomSetImpl.In  x  (dom  W2 )  ->
     ctx_sub  (  ( x ~( psi1 , A ))  ++ W1 )   (  ( x ~( psi2 , A ))  ++ W2 ) .

Inductive GDefEq : econtext -> grade -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | GE_Var : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (x:tmvar) (psi0:grade),
      uniq  P  ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
      binds  x   psi0   P  ->
     GDefEq P psi (a_Var_f x) (a_Var_f x)
 | GE_Type : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (s:sort),
      uniq  P  ->
     GDefEq P psi (a_Type s) (a_Type s)
 | GE_Sym : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (b a:tm),
     GDefEq P psi a b ->
     GDefEq P psi b a
 | GE_Trans : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a b b0:tm),
     GDefEq P psi a b0 ->
     GDefEq P psi b0 b ->
     GDefEq P psi a b
 | GE_App : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (b0:tm) (psi0:grade) (a0 b1 a1:tm),
     GDefEq P psi b0 b1 ->
     CGDefEq P psi psi0 a0 a1 ->
     GDefEq P psi (a_App b0 psi0 a0) (a_App b1 psi0 a1)
 | GE_Abs : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (A0 b0 A1 b1:tm),
     lc_tm A0 ->
     lc_tm A1 ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> GDefEq  (  ( x ~ psi0 )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm b0 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm b1 (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     GDefEq P psi (a_Abs psi0 A0 b0) (a_Abs psi0 A1 b1)
 | GE_Pi : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (A0 B0 A1 B1:tm),
     GDefEq P psi A0 A1 ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> GDefEq  (  ( x ~ psi0 )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B0 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     GDefEq P psi (a_Pi psi0 A0 B0) (a_Pi psi0 A1 B1)
 | GE_AppAbs : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a:tm) (psi0:grade) (b0 a0 b1 A:tm),
     GDefEq P psi a (a_Abs psi0 A a0) ->
     CGDefEq P psi psi0 b0 b1 ->
     GDefEq P psi (a_App a psi0 b0)  (open_tm_wrt_tm  a0   b1 )
 | GE_Refl : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade),
      uniq  P  ->
     GDefEq P psi a_Refl a_Refl
 | GE_Transp : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a0 b0 a1 b1:tm),
     GDefEq P psi a0 a1 ->
     GDefEq P psi b0 b1 ->
     GDefEq P psi (a_Transp a0 b0) (a_Transp a1 b1)
 | GE_CEq : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a0 b0:tm) (psi1:grade) (A0 a1 b1 A1:tm),
     lc_tm A0 ->
     lc_tm A1 ->
     GDefEq P psi a0 a1 ->
     GDefEq P psi b0 b1 ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     GDefEq P psi (a_CEq psi0 a0 b0 psi1 A0) (a_CEq psi0 a1 b1 psi1 A1)
 | GE_TranspRefl : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a0 b0 b1:tm),
     GDefEq P psi a0 a_Refl ->
     GDefEq P psi b0 b1 ->
     GDefEq P psi (a_Transp a0 b0) b1
 | GE_T : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (A B:tm),
     GDefEq P psi A B ->
     GDefEq P psi (a_T psi0 A) (a_T psi0 B)
 | GE_Box : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a b:tm),
     CGDefEq P psi psi0 a b ->
     GDefEq P psi (a_Box psi0 a) (a_Box psi0 b)
 | GE_Unbox : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a b:tm),
     GDefEq P psi a b ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     GDefEq P psi (a_Unbox psi0 a) (a_Unbox psi0 b)
 | GE_UnboxBox : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a b:tm),
     GDefEq P psi a (a_Box psi0 b) ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     GDefEq P psi (a_Unbox psi0 a) b
 | GE_Proj1Cong : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a0 a1:tm),
     GDefEq P psi a0 a1 ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     GDefEq P psi (a_Proj1 psi0 a0) (a_Proj1 psi0 a1)
 | GE_Proj2Cong : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a0 a1:tm),
     GDefEq P psi a0 a1 ->
     GDefEq P psi (a_Proj2 psi0 a0) (a_Proj2 psi0 a1)
 | GE_Proj1Beta : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (b a1 a2:tm),
     GDefEq P psi b (a_SPair a1 psi0 a2) ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     GDefEq P psi (a_Proj1 psi0 b) a1
 | GE_Proj2Beta : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (b a2 a1:tm),
     GDefEq P psi b (a_SPair a1 psi0 a2) ->
     GDefEq P psi (a_Proj2 psi0 b) a2
 | GE_SPair : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a0:tm) (psi0:grade) (b0 a1 b1:tm),
     CGDefEq P psi psi0 a0 a1 ->
     GDefEq P psi b0 b1 ->
     GDefEq P psi (a_SPair a0 psi0 b0) (a_SPair a1 psi0 b1)
 | GE_SSigma : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (A0 B0 A1 B1:tm),
     GDefEq P psi A0 A1 ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> GDefEq  (  ( x ~ psi0 )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B0 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     GDefEq P psi (a_SSigma psi0 A0 B0) (a_SSigma psi0 A1 B1)
 | GE_TyUnit : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade),
      uniq  P  ->
     GDefEq P psi a_TyUnit a_TyUnit
 | GE_TmUnit : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade),
      uniq  P  ->
     GDefEq P psi a_TmUnit a_TmUnit
 | GE_Bool : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade),
      uniq  P  ->
     GDefEq P psi a_Bool a_Bool
 | GE_True : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade),
      uniq  P  ->
     GDefEq P psi a_True a_True
 | GE_False : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade),
      uniq  P  ->
     GDefEq P psi a_False a_False
 | GE_If : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a0 b0 b1 a1 b2 b3:tm),
     GDefEq P psi a0 a1 ->
     GDefEq P psi b0 b2 ->
     GDefEq P psi b1 b3 ->
     GDefEq P psi (a_If a0 b0 b1) (a_If a1 b2 b3)
 | GE_IfTrue : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a0 b0 b1 b2 b3:tm),
     GDefEq P psi a0 a_True ->
     GDefEq P psi b0 b2 ->
     GDefEq P psi b1 b3 ->
     GDefEq P psi (a_If a0 b0 b1) b2
 | GE_IfFalse : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a0 b0 b1 b3 b2:tm),
     GDefEq P psi a0 a_False ->
     GDefEq P psi b0 b2 ->
     GDefEq P psi b1 b3 ->
     GDefEq P psi (a_If a0 b0 b1) b3
with CGDefEq : econtext -> grade -> grade -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | CGE_Leq : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a b:tm),
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     GDefEq P psi a b ->
     CGDefEq P psi psi0 a b
 | CGE_NLeq : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a b:tm),
     lc_tm a ->
     lc_tm b ->
      not ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
      uniq  P  ->
     CGDefEq P psi psi0 a b.

Inductive DefEq : econtext -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | E_One : forall (P:econtext) (a b:tm) (psi:grade),
     GDefEq P psi a b ->
     DefEq P a b
 | E_Trans : forall (P:econtext) (a b b0:tm),
     DefEq P a b0 ->
     DefEq P b0 b ->
     DefEq P a b.

Inductive Ctx : context -> Prop :=
 | Ctx_Empty :
     Ctx  nil
 | Ctx_Cons : forall (W:context) (x:tmvar) (psi0:grade) (A:tm) (psi:grade) (s:sort),
     Ctx W ->
     Typing W psi A (a_Type s) ->
      ~ AtomSetImpl.In  x  (dom  W )  ->
     Ctx  (  ( x ~( psi0 , A ))  ++ W )
with Typing : context -> grade -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | T_Type : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (s1 s2:sort),
     Ctx W ->
      axiom  s1   s2  ->
     Typing W psi (a_Type s1) (a_Type s2)
 | T_Var : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (x:tmvar) (A:tm) (psi0:grade),
     Ctx W ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
      binds  x  ( psi0 ,  A )  W  ->
     Typing W psi (a_Var_f x) A
 | T_Pi : forall (L:vars) (W:context) (psi psi0:grade) (A B:tm) (s3 s1 s2:sort),
     Typing W psi A (a_Type s1) ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Typing  (  ( x ~( psi0 , A ))  ++ W )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )  (a_Type s2) )  ->
      rule_pi  s1   s2   s3  ->
     Typing W psi (a_Pi psi0 A B) (a_Type s3)
 | T_Abs : forall (L:vars) (W:context) (psi psi0:grade) (A b B:tm) (psi1:grade) (s:sort),
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Typing  (  ( x ~( psi0 , A ))  ++ W )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm b (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     Typing W psi1  ( (a_Pi psi0 A B) )  (a_Type s) ->
     Typing W psi (a_Abs psi0 A b) (a_Pi psi0 A B)
 | T_App : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (b:tm) (psi0:grade) (a B A:tm),
     Typing W psi b (a_Pi psi0 A B) ->
     Typing W psi0 a A ->
     Typing W psi (a_App b psi0 a)  (open_tm_wrt_tm  B   a )
 | T_Conv : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (a B A:tm) (psi0:grade) (s:sort),
     Typing W psi a A ->
     Typing W psi0 B (a_Type s) ->
     DefEq  (labels  W )  A B ->
     Typing W psi a B
 | T_Refl : forall (W:context) (psi psi0:grade) (a:tm) (psi1:grade) (A:tm) (psi2:grade) (s:sort),
     Typing W psi2  (a_CEq psi0 a a psi1 A)  (a_Type s) ->
     Typing W psi a_Refl  (a_CEq psi0 a a psi1 A)
 | T_CEq : forall (W:context) (psi psi0:grade) (a b:tm) (psi1:grade) (A:tm) (s2:sort) (psi2:grade) (s1:sort),
     Typing W psi1 a A ->
     Typing W psi1 b A ->
     Typing W psi2 A (a_Type s1) ->
      rule_eq  s1   s2  ->
      ( psi1  <=  psi0 )  ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     Typing W psi  (a_CEq psi0 a b psi1 A)  (a_Type s2)
 | T_Transp : forall (L:vars) (W:context) (psi:grade) (a b B a1:tm) (psi0:grade) (A:tm) (psi1:grade) (s:sort) (a0:tm) (psi2:grade) (s1:sort),
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Typing  (  ( x ~( psi1 , A ))  ++ W )  psi0  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )  (a_Type s) )  ->
     Typing W psi a  (a_CEq psi0 a0 a1 psi1 A)  ->
     Typing W psi b  (open_tm_wrt_tm  B   a0 )  ->
      Typing W psi2 A (a_Type s1)  ->
     Typing W psi (a_Transp a b)  (open_tm_wrt_tm  B   a1 )
 | T_T : forall (W:context) (psi psi0:grade) (A:tm) (s2 s1:sort),
     Typing W psi A (a_Type s1) ->
      rule_t  s1   s2  ->
     Typing W psi (a_T psi0 A) (a_Type s2)
 | T_Box : forall (W:context) (psi psi0:grade) (a A:tm) (psi1:grade) (s:sort),
     Typing W psi0 a A ->
     Typing W psi1 (a_T psi0 A) (a_Type s) ->
     Typing W psi (a_Box psi0 a) (a_T psi0 A)
 | T_Unbox : forall (W:context) (psi psi0:grade) (a A:tm),
     Typing W psi a (a_T psi0 A) ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     Typing W psi (a_Unbox psi0 a) A
 | T_SSigma : forall (L:vars) (W:context) (psi psi0:grade) (A B:tm) (s3 s1 s2:sort),
     Typing W psi A (a_Type s1) ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Typing  (  ( x ~( psi0 , A ))  ++ W )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )  (a_Type s2) )  ->
      rule_sig  s1   s2   s3  ->
     Typing W psi (a_SSigma psi0 A B) (a_Type s3)
 | T_SPair : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (a:tm) (psi0:grade) (b A B:tm) (psi1:grade) (s:sort),
     Typing W psi1 (a_SSigma psi0 A B) (a_Type s) ->
     Typing W psi0 a A ->
     Typing W psi b  (open_tm_wrt_tm  B   a )  ->
     Typing W psi (a_SPair a psi0 b) (a_SSigma psi0 A B)
 | T_Proj1 : forall (W:context) (psi psi0:grade) (a A B:tm),
     Typing W psi a (a_SSigma psi0 A B) ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     Typing W psi (a_Proj1 psi0 a) A
 | T_Proj2 : forall (W:context) (psi psi0:grade) (a B A:tm),
     Typing W psi a (a_SSigma psi0 A B) ->
     Typing W psi0 (a_Proj1 psi0 a) A ->
     Typing W psi (a_Proj2 psi0 a)  (open_tm_wrt_tm  B   (a_Proj1 psi0 a) )
 | T_TyUnit : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (s:sort),
     Ctx W ->
      rule_unit  s  ->
     Typing W psi a_TyUnit (a_Type s)
 | T_TmUnit : forall (W:context) (psi psi0:grade) (s:sort),
     Typing W psi0 a_TyUnit (a_Type s) ->
     Typing W psi a_TmUnit a_TyUnit
 | T_Bool : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (s:sort),
     Ctx W ->
      rule_bool  s  ->
     Typing W psi a_Bool (a_Type s)
 | T_True : forall (W:context) (psi psi0:grade) (s:sort),
     Typing W psi0 a_Bool (a_Type s) ->
     Typing W psi a_True a_Bool
 | T_False : forall (W:context) (psi psi0:grade) (s:sort),
     Typing W psi0 a_Bool (a_Type s) ->
     Typing W psi a_False a_Bool
 | T_If : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (a b0 b1 A:tm),
     Typing W psi a a_Bool ->
     Typing W psi b0 A ->
     Typing W psi b1 A ->
     Typing W psi (a_If a b0 b1) A.

Inductive Red : tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | R_App : forall (a0:tm) (psi0:grade) (b a1:tm),
     lc_tm b ->
     Red a0 a1 ->
     Red (a_App a0 psi0 b) (a_App a1 psi0 b)
 | R_AppAbs : forall (psi0:grade) (A a b:tm),
     lc_tm A ->
     lc_tm (a_Abs psi0 A a) ->
     lc_tm b ->
     Red (a_App  ( (a_Abs psi0 A a) )  psi0 b)  (open_tm_wrt_tm  a   b )
 | R_Transp : forall (a b a0:tm),
     lc_tm b ->
     Red a a0 ->
     Red (a_Transp a b) (a_Transp a0 b)
 | R_TranspRefl : forall (a:tm),
     lc_tm a ->
     Red (a_Transp a_Refl a) a
 | R_Unbox : forall (psi0:grade) (a a0:tm),
     Red a a0 ->
     Red (a_Unbox psi0 a) (a_Unbox psi0 a0)
 | R_UnboxBox : forall (psi0:grade) (a:tm),
     lc_tm a ->
     Red (a_Unbox psi0  ( (a_Box psi0 a) ) ) a
 | R_Proj1Cong : forall (psi:grade) (a a':tm),
     Red a a' ->
     Red (a_Proj1 psi a) (a_Proj1 psi a')
 | R_Proj2Cong : forall (psi:grade) (a a':tm),
     Red a a' ->
     Red (a_Proj2 psi a) (a_Proj2 psi a')
 | R_Proj1Beta : forall (psi:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
     lc_tm a2 ->
     lc_tm a1 ->
     Red (a_Proj1 psi (a_SPair a1 psi a2)) a1
 | R_Proj2Beta : forall (psi:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
     lc_tm a1 ->
     lc_tm a2 ->
     Red (a_Proj2 psi (a_SPair a1 psi a2)) a2
 | R_If : forall (a b0 b1 a':tm),
     lc_tm b0 ->
     lc_tm b1 ->
     Red a a' ->
     Red (a_If a b0 b1) (a_If a' b0 b1)
 | R_IfTrue : forall (b0 b1:tm),
     lc_tm b1 ->
     lc_tm b0 ->
     Red (a_If a_True b0 b1) b0
 | R_IfFalse : forall (b0 b1:tm),
     lc_tm b0 ->
     lc_tm b1 ->
     Red (a_If a_False b0 b1) b1.

Inductive Reds : tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | Rs_Refl : forall (a:tm),
     lc_tm a ->
     Reds a a
 | Rs_Step : forall (a0 a1 b:tm),
     Red a0 b ->
     Reds b a1 ->
     Reds a0 a1.

Inductive CPar : econtext -> grade -> grade -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | CPar_Leq : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     Par P psi a1 a2 ->
     CPar P psi psi0 a1 a2

with Par : econtext -> grade -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | Par_Var : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (x:tmvar) (psi0:grade),
      uniq  P  ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
      binds  x   psi0   P  ->
     Par P psi (a_Var_f x) (a_Var_f x)
 | Par_Type : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (s:sort),
      uniq  P  ->
     Par P psi (a_Type s) (a_Type s)
 | Par_Pi : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi1:grade) (A1 B1 A2 B2:tm),
     Par P psi A1 A2 ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Par  (  ( x ~ psi1 )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B2 (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     Par P psi (a_Pi psi1 A1 B1) (a_Pi psi1 A2 B2)
 | Par_AppBeta : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a:tm) (psi0:grade) (b a' b' A:tm),
     Par P psi a  ( (a_Abs psi0 A a') )  ->
     CPar P psi psi0 b b' ->
     Par P psi (a_App a psi0 b)  (open_tm_wrt_tm  a'   b' )
 | Par_App : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a:tm) (psi0:grade) (b a' b':tm),
     Par P psi a a' ->
     CPar P psi psi0 b b' ->
     Par P psi (a_App a psi0 b) (a_App a' psi0 b')
 | Par_Abs : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (A1 b1 A2 b2:tm),
     lc_tm A1 ->
     lc_tm A2 ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Par  (  ( x ~ psi0 )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm b1 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm b2 (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     Par P psi (a_Abs psi0 A1 b1) (a_Abs psi0 A2 b2)
 | Par_Refl : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade),
      uniq  P  ->
     Par P psi a_Refl a_Refl
 | Par_Transp : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a0 b0 a1 b1:tm),
     Par P psi a0 a1 ->
     Par P psi b0 b1 ->
     Par P psi (a_Transp a0 b0) (a_Transp a1 b1)

Inductive EPar : econtext -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | EP_One : forall (P:econtext) (a b:tm) (psi:grade),
     Par P psi a b ->
     EPar P a b.

Inductive EMPar : econtext -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | EMP_One : forall (P:econtext) (a b:tm),
     EPar P a b ->
     EMPar P a b
 | EMP_Step : forall (P:econtext) (a a' b:tm),
     EPar P a b ->
     EMPar P b a' ->
     EMPar P a a'.

Inductive EJoins : econtext -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | EJ_ejoins : forall (P:econtext) (a1 a2 b:tm),
     EMPar P a1 b ->
     EMPar P a2 b ->
     EJoins P a1 a2.

Inductive MultiPar : econtext -> grade -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | MP_One : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a b:tm),
     Par P psi a b ->
     MultiPar P psi a b
 | MP_Step : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a a' b:tm),
     Par P psi a b ->
     MultiPar P psi b a' ->
     MultiPar P psi a a'.

Inductive Joins : econtext -> grade -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | join : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a1 a2 b:tm),
     MultiPar P psi a1 b ->
     MultiPar P psi a2 b ->
     Joins P psi a1 a2.

Inductive CMultiPar : econtext -> grade -> grade -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | CMP_Leq : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     MultiPar P psi a1 a2 ->
     CMultiPar P psi psi0 a1 a2
 | CMP_Nleq : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
     lc_tm a1 ->
     lc_tm a2 ->
      not ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
      uniq  P  ->
     CMultiPar P psi psi0 a1 a2.

Inductive CJoins : econtext -> grade -> grade -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | CJ_Leq : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     Joins P psi a1 a2 ->
     CJoins P psi psi0 a1 a2
 | CJ_Nleq : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
     lc_tm a1 ->
     lc_tm a2 ->
      not ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
      uniq  P  ->
     CJoins P psi psi0 a1 a2.

From Qual Require Import Qualitative_ott.
From mathcomp Require Import ssreflect ssrbool.
Set Implicit Arguments.
Unset Strict Implicit.
Unset Printing Implicit Defensive.
Local Open Scope order_scope.

(* =====================  Headform inversion helpers  ===================== *)

Lemma hf_pi_inv : forall (t:tm) (g:grade),
  tm_to_headform t = Some (h_Pi g) -> exists A B, t = a_Pi g A B.
Proof.
  intros t g H. destruct t; simpl in H; try discriminate H.
  inversion H; subst. eauto.
Qed.

Lemma hf_ceq_inv : forall (t:tm) (g g':grade),
  tm_to_headform t = Some (h_CEq g g') ->
  exists a b A, t = a_CEq g a b g' A.
Proof.
  intros t g g' H. destruct t; simpl in H; try discriminate H.
  inversion H; subst. eauto.
Qed.

Lemma hf_t_inv : forall (t:tm) (g:grade),
  tm_to_headform t = Some (h_T g) -> exists A, t = a_T g A.
Proof.
  intros t g H. destruct t; simpl in H; try discriminate H.
  inversion H; subst. eauto.
Qed.

Lemma hf_ssigma_inv : forall (t:tm) (g:grade),
  tm_to_headform t = Some (h_SSigma g) -> exists A B, t = a_SSigma g A B.
Proof.
  intros t g H. destruct t; simpl in H; try discriminate H.
  inversion H; subst. eauto.
Qed.

Lemma hf_bool_inv : forall (t:tm),
  tm_to_headform t = Some h_Bool -> t = a_Bool.
Proof.
  intros t H. destruct t; simpl in H; try discriminate H.
  inversion H. reflexivity.
Qed.

(* =====================  Headform preservation by GDefEq / DefEq  ============ *)

Lemma gdefeq_headform : forall P psi a b,
  GDefEq P psi a b ->
  (forall h, tm_to_headform a = Some h -> tm_to_headform b = Some h) /\
  (forall h, tm_to_headform b = Some h -> tm_to_headform a = Some h).
Proof.
  intros P psi a b H.
  induction H.
  all: try (split; intros h Hh; simpl in Hh; try discriminate Hh;
            try discriminate; try assumption; try reflexivity).
  - (* GE_Sym *) destruct IH as [I1 I2]. split; assumption.
  - (* GE_Trans *) destruct IH1 as [I1a I1b]. destruct IH2 as [I2a I2b].
    split; intros h Hh; [ apply I2a; apply I1a | apply I1b; apply I2b ]; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma defeq_headform : forall P a b,
  DefEq P a b ->
  (forall h, tm_to_headform a = Some h -> tm_to_headform b = Some h) /\
  (forall h, tm_to_headform b = Some h -> tm_to_headform a = Some h).
Proof.
  intros P a b H. induction H.
  - apply gdefeq_headform; assumption.
  - destruct IH1 as [I1a I1b]. destruct IH2 as [I2a I2b].
    split; intros h Hh; [ apply I2a; apply I1a | apply I1b; apply I2b ]; assumption.
Qed.

(* =====================  Typing regularities: lc of terms  ==================== *)

Lemma typing_lc : forall W psi a A, Typing W psi a A -> lc_tm a.
Proof.
  intros W psi a A H. induction H.
  - (* T_Type *) constructor.
  - (* T_Var *) constructor.
  - (* T_Pi *) econstructor; eauto.
  - (* T_Abs *)
    econstructor; [ | eauto ].
    (* lc of the annotation from lc of the Pi type *)
    inversion IHH1. assumption.
  - (* T_App *) econstructor; eauto.
  - (* T_Conv *) assumption.
  - (* T_Refl *) constructor.
  - (* T_CEq *) econstructor; eauto.
  - (* T_Transp *) econstructor; eauto.
  - (* T_T *) econstructor; eauto.
  - (* T_Box *) econstructor; eauto.
  - (* T_Unbox *) econstructor; eauto.
  - (* T_SSigma *) econstructor; eauto.
  - (* T_SPair *) econstructor; eauto.
  - (* T_Proj1 *) econstructor; eauto.
  - (* T_Proj2 *) econstructor; eauto.
  - (* T_TyUnit *) constructor.
  - (* T_TmUnit *) constructor.
  - (* T_Bool *) constructor.
  - (* T_True *) constructor.
  - (* T_False *) constructor.
  - (* T_If *) econstructor; eauto.
Qed.
EOF

cd /workspace; cat > /tmp/pl/found.v <<'EOF'
From Qual Require Import Qualitative_ott.
From mathcomp Require Import ssreflect ssrbool.
From Coq Require Import Lia.
Set Implicit Arguments.
Unset Strict Implicit.
Unset Printing Implicit Defensive.
Local Open Scope order_scope.
Local Close Scope bool_scope.

(* ============  Well-scopedness (no dangling de Bruijn indices)  ============ *)

Fixpoint wf (k:nat) (t:tm) : Prop :=
  match t with
  | a_TyUnit => True
  | a_TmUnit => True
  | a_Pi _ A B => wf k A /\ wf (S k) B
  | a_Abs _ A b => wf k A /\ wf (S k) b
  | a_App a _ b => wf k a /\ wf k b
  | a_Type _ => True
  | a_Var_b n => n < k
  | a_Var_f _ => True
  | a_CEq _ a b _ A => wf k a /\ wf k b /\ wf k A
  | a_Refl => True
  | a_Transp a b => wf k a /\ wf k b
  | a_T _ A => wf k A
  | a_Box _ a => wf k a
  | a_Unbox _ a => wf k a
  | a_SSigma _ A B => wf k A /\ wf (S k) B
  | a_SPair a _ b => wf k a /\ wf k b
  | a_Proj1 _ a => wf k a
  | a_Proj2 _ a => wf k a
  | a_Bool => True
  | a_True => True
  | a_False => True
  | a_If a b0 b1 => wf k a /\ wf k b0 /\ wf k b1
  end.

Lemma wf_open_var : forall t k x,
  wf (S k) t <-> wf k (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k t (a_Var_f x)).
Proof.
  induction t; intros k x; simpl.
  - tauto. - tauto. - tauto. - tauto. - tauto. - tauto.
  - (* a_Var_b *)
    destruct (lt_eq_lt_dec n k) as [[H|H]|H]; simpl; lia.
  - tauto.
  - rewrite IHt1, IHt2, IHt3. tauto.
  - tauto. - rewrite IHt1, IHt2. tauto.
  - rewrite IHt. tauto.
  - rewrite IHt. tauto.
  - rewrite IHt. tauto.
  - rewrite IHt1, IHt2. tauto.
  - rewrite IHt1, IHt2. tauto.
  - rewrite IHt. tauto.
  - rewrite IHt. tauto.
  - tauto. - tauto. - tauto.
  - rewrite IHt1, IHt2, IHt3. tauto.
Qed.

(* size, used for the strong induction in wf -> lc *)
Fixpoint tm_size (t:tm) : nat :=
  match t with
  | a_TyUnit | a_TmUnit | a_Type _ | a_Var_b _ | a_Var_f _ | a_Refl
  | a_Bool | a_True | a_False => 1
  | a_Pi _ A B => S (tm_size A + tm_size B)
  | a_Abs _ A b => S (tm_size A + tm_size b)
  | a_App a _ b => S (tm_size a + tm_size b)
  | a_CEq _ a b _ A => S (tm_size a + tm_size b + tm_size A)
  | a_Transp a b => S (tm_size a + tm_size b)
  | a_T _ A => S (tm_size A)
  | a_Box _ a => S (tm_size a)
  | a_Unbox _ a => S (tm_size a)
  | a_SSigma _ A B => S (tm_size A + tm_size B)
  | a_SPair a _ b => S (tm_size a + tm_size b)
  | a_Proj1 _ a => S (tm_size a)
  | a_Proj2 _ a => S (tm_size a)
  | a_If a b0 b1 => S (tm_size a + tm_size b0 + tm_size b1)
  end.

Lemma tm_size_open_var : forall t k x,
  tm_size (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k t (a_Var_f x)) = tm_size t.
Proof.
  induction t; intros k x; simpl.
  - reflexivity. - reflexivity. - reflexivity. - reflexivity. - reflexivity. - reflexivity.
  - destruct (lt_eq_lt_dec n k); simpl; reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHt1, IHt2, IHt3; reflexivity.
  - reflexivity. - rewrite IHt1, IHt2; reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHt; reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHt; reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHt; reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHt1, IHt2; reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHt1, IHt2; reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHt; reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHt; reflexivity.
  - reflexivity. - reflexivity. - reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHt1, IHt2, IHt3; reflexivity.
Qed.

(* wf 0 implies local closure *)
Lemma wf_lc_aux : forall n t, tm_size t <= n -> wf 0 t -> lc_tm t.
Proof.
  induction n as [| n IH]; intros t Hle Hwf.
  - destruct t; simpl in Hle; lia.
  - destruct t; simpl in *; try constructor; try tauto;
    try (constructor; tauto).
    + (* a_Pi *)
      destruct Hwf as [HA HB]. apply lc_a_Pi; [ exact (IH _ ltac:(simpl; lia) HA) | ].
      intro x. apply (IH (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec 0 B (a_Var_f x))).
      * rewrite tm_size_open_var. simpl in Hle. lia.
      * apply (proj1 (wf_open_var B 0 x)). exact HB.
    + (* a_Abs *)
      destruct Hwf as [HA HB]. apply lc_a_Abs; [ exact (IH _ ltac:(simpl; lia) HA) | ].
      intro x. apply (IH (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec 0 b (a_Var_f x))).
      * rewrite tm_size_open_var. simpl in Hle. lia.
      * apply (proj1 (wf_open_var b 0 x)). exact HB.
    + (* a_App *)
      destruct Hwf as [Ha Hb]. constructor.
      * exact (IH _ ltac:(simpl in Hle; lia) Ha).
      * exact (IH _ ltac:(simpl in Hle; lia) Hb).
    + (* a_CEq *)
      destruct Hwf as [Ha [Hb Hc]]. econstructor.
      * exact (IH _ ltac:(simpl in Hle; lia) Ha).
      * exact (IH _ ltac:(simpl in Hle; lia) Hb).
      * exact (IH _ ltac:(simpl in Hle; lia) Hc).
    + (* a_Transp *) destruct Hwf as [Ha Hb]. constructor; [exact (IH _ ltac:(simpl in Hle; lia) Ha)|exact (IH _ ltac:(simpl in Hle; lia) Hb)].
    + (* a_T *) destruct Hwf as [HA]. constructor. exact (IH _ ltac:(simpl in Hle; lia) HA).
    + (* a_Box *) destruct Hwf as [Ha]. constructor. exact (IH _ ltac:(simpl in Hle; lia) Ha).
    + (* a_Unbox *) destruct Hwf as [Ha]. constructor. exact (IH _ ltac:(simpl in Hle; lia) Ha).
    + (* a_SSigma *)
      destruct Hwf as [HA HB]. apply lc_a_SSigma; [ exact (IH _ ltac:(simpl; lia) HA) | ].
      intro x. apply (IH (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec 0 B (a_Var_f x))).
      * rewrite tm_size_open_var. simpl in Hle. lia.
      * apply (proj1 (wf_open_var B 0 x)). exact HB.
    + (* a_SPair *) destruct Hwf as [Ha Hb]. constructor; [exact (IH _ ltac:(simpl in Hle; lia) Ha)|exact (IH _ ltac:(simpl in Hle; lia) Hb)].
    + (* a_Proj1 *) destruct Hwf as [Ha]. constructor. exact (IH _ ltac:(simpl in Hle; lia) Ha).
    + (* a_Proj2 *) destruct Hwf as [Ha]. constructor. exact (IH _ ltac:(simpl in Hle; lia) Ha).
    + (* a_If *) destruct Hwf as [Ha [Hb Hc]]. econstructor; [exact (IH _ ltac:(simpl in Hle; lia) Ha)|exact (IH _ ltac:(simpl in Hle; lia) Hb)|exact (IH _ ltac:(simpl in Hle; lia) Hc)].
Qed.

Lemma wf_lc : forall t, wf 0 t -> lc_tm t.
Proof. intros t H. exact (wf_lc_aux (tm_size t) t (le_n _) H). Qed.

Lemma lc_wf : forall t, lc_tm t -> wf 0 t.
Proof.
  intros t H. induction H using lc_tm_ind; simpl; try tauto; try (split; tauto).
  - (* a_Pi *) split. tauto.
    destruct (atom_fresh AtomSetImpl.empty) as [x Hx].
    apply (proj2 (wf_open_var B 0 x)); auto.
  - (* a_Abs *) split. tauto.
    destruct (atom_fresh AtomSetImpl.empty) as [x Hx].
    apply (proj2 (wf_open_var a 0 x)); auto.
  - (* a_CEq *) tauto.
  - (* a_SSigma *) split. tauto.
    destruct (atom_fresh AtomSetImpl.empty) as [x Hx].
    apply (proj2 (wf_open_var B 0 x)); auto.
  - (* a_SPair *) split; tauto.
  - (* a_If *) tauto.
Qed.

Lemma lc_wf_iff : forall t, lc_tm t <-> wf 0 t.
Proof. intro t; split; [apply lc_wf | apply wf_lc]. Qed.
EOF

From Qual Require Import Qualitative_ott.
From mathcomp Require Import ssreflect ssrbool.
From Coq Require Import Lia.
Set Implicit Arguments.
Unset Strict Implicit.
Unset Printing Implicit Defensive.
Local Open Scope order_scope.
Local Close Scope bool_scope.

Fixpoint wf (k:nat) (t:tm) : Prop :=
  match t with
  | a_TyUnit => True
  | a_TmUnit => True
  | a_Pi _ A B => wf k A /\ wf (S k) B
  | a_Abs _ A b => wf k A /\ wf (S k) b
  | a_App a _ b => wf k a /\ wf k b
  | a_Type _ => True
  | a_Var_b n => n < k
  | a_Var_f _ => True
  | a_CEq _ a b _ A => wf k a /\ wf k b /\ wf k A
  | a_Refl => True
  | a_Transp a b => wf k a /\ wf k b
  | a_T _ A => wf k A
  | a_Box _ a => wf k a
  | a_Unbox _ a => wf k a
  | a_SSigma _ A B => wf k A /\ wf (S k) B
  | a_SPair a _ b => wf k a /\ wf k b
  | a_Proj1 _ a => wf k a
  | a_Proj2 _ a => wf k a
  | a_Bool => True
  | a_True => True
  | a_False => True
  | a_If a b0 b1 => wf k a /\ wf k b0 /\ wf k b1
  end.

Lemma wf_open_var : forall t k x,
  wf (S k) t <-> wf k (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k t (a_Var_f x)).
Proof.
  induction t; intros k x; simpl.
  - tauto. - tauto. - tauto. - tauto. - tauto. - tauto.
  - destruct (lt_eq_lt_dec n k) as [[H|H]|H]; simpl; lia.
  - tauto.
  - rewrite IHt1, IHt2, IHt3. tauto.
  - tauto. - rewrite IHt1, IHt2. tauto.
  - rewrite IHt. tauto.
  - rewrite IHt. tauto.
  - rewrite IHt. tauto.
  - rewrite IHt1, IHt2. tauto.
  - rewrite IHt1, IHt2. tauto.
  - rewrite IHt. tauto.
  - rewrite IHt. tauto.
  - tauto. - tauto. - tauto.
  - rewrite IHt1, IHt2, IHt3. tauto.
Qed.

Fixpoint tm_size (t:tm) : nat :=
  match t with
  | a_TyUnit | a_TmUnit | a_Type _ | a_Var_b _ | a_Var_f _ | a_Refl
  | a_Bool | a_True | a_False => 1
  | a_Pi _ A B => S (tm_size A + tm_size B)
  | a_Abs _ A b => S (tm_size A + tm_size b)
  | a_App a _ b => S (tm_size a + tm_size b)
  | a_CEq _ a b _ A => S (tm_size a + tm_size b + tm_size A)
  | a_Transp a b => S (tm_size a + tm_size b)
  | a_T _ A => S (tm_size A)
  | a_Box _ a => S (tm_size a)
  | a_Unbox _ a => S (tm_size a)
  | a_SSigma _ A B => S (tm_size A + tm_size B)
  | a_SPair a _ b => S (tm_size a + tm_size b)
  | a_Proj1 _ a => S (tm_size a)
  | a_Proj2 _ a => S (tm_size a)
  | a_If a b0 b1 => S (tm_size a + tm_size b0 + tm_size b1)
  end.

  tm_size (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k t (a_Var_f x)) = tm_size t.
Proof.
  induction t; intros k x; simpl.
  - reflexivity. - reflexivity. - reflexivity. - reflexivity. - reflexivity. - reflexivity.
  - destruct (lt_eq_lt_dec n k); simpl; reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHt1, IHt2, IHt3; reflexivity.
  - reflexivity. - rewrite IHt1, IHt2; reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHt; reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHt; reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHt; reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHt1, IHt2; reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHt1, IHt2; reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHt; reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHt; reflexivity.
  - reflexivity. - reflexivity. - reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHt1, IHt2, IHt3; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma wf_lc_aux : forall n t, tm_size t <= n -> wf 0 t -> lc_tm t.
Proof.
  induction n as [| n IH]; intros t Hle Hwf.
  - destruct t; simpl in Hle; lia.
  - destruct t; simpl in *; try constructor; try tauto;
    try (constructor; tauto).
    + destruct Hwf as [HA HB]. apply lc_a_Pi; [ exact (IH _ ltac:(simpl; lia) HA) | ].
      intro x. apply (IH (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec 0 B (a_Var_f x))).
      * rewrite tm_size_open_var. simpl in Hle. lia.

    + destruct Hwf as [HA HB]. apply lc_a_Abs; [ exact (IH _ ltac:(simpl; lia) HA) | ].

      * rewrite tm_size_open_var. simpl in Hle. lia.
      * apply (proj1 (wf_open_var b 0 x)). exact HB.
    + destruct Hwf as [Ha Hb]. constructor.
      * exact (IH _ ltac:(simpl in Hle; lia) Ha).
      * exact (IH _ ltac:(simpl in Hle; lia) Hb).
    + destruct Hwf as [Ha [Hb Hc]]. econstructor.
      * exact (IH _ ltac:(simpl in Hle; lia) Ha).
      * exact (IH _ ltac:(simpl in Hle; lia) Hb).
      * exact (IH _ ltac:(simpl in Hle; lia) Hc).
    + destruct Hwf as [Ha Hb]. constructor; [exact (IH _ ltac:(simpl in Hle; lia) Ha)|exact (IH _ ltac:(simpl in Hle; lia) Hb)].
    + destruct Hwf as [HA]. constructor. exact (IH _ ltac:(simpl in Hle; lia) HA).
    + destruct Hwf as [Ha]. constructor. exact (IH _ ltac:(simpl in Hle; lia) Ha).
    + destruct Hwf as [Ha]. constructor. exact (IH _ ltac:(simpl in Hle; lia) Ha).
    + destruct Hwf as [HA HB]. apply lc_a_SSigma; [ exact (IH _ ltac:(simpl; lia) HA) | ].
      intro x. apply (IH (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec 0 B (a_Var_f x))).
      * rewrite tm_size_open_var. simpl in Hle. lia.
      * apply (proj1 (wf_open_var B 0 x)). exact HB.
    + destruct Hwf as [Ha Hb]. constructor; [exact (IH _ ltac:(simpl in Hle; lia) Ha)|exact (IH _ ltac:(simpl in Hle; lia) Hb)].
    + destruct Hwf as [Ha]. constructor. exact (IH _ ltac:(simpl in Hle; lia) Ha).
    + destruct Hwf as [Ha]. constructor. exact (IH _ ltac:(simpl in Hle; lia) Ha).
    + destruct Hwf as [Ha [Hb Hc]]. econstructor; [exact (IH _ ltac:(simpl in Hle; lia) Ha)|exact (IH _ ltac:(simpl in Hle; lia) Hb)|exact (IH _ ltac:(simpl in Hle; lia) Hc)].
Qed.

Lemma wf_lc : forall t, wf 0 t -> lc_tm t.
Proof. intros t H. exact (wf_lc_aux (tm_size t) t (le_n _) H). Qed.

Lemma lc_wf : forall t, lc_tm t -> wf 0 t.
Proof.
  intros t H. induction H using lc_tm_ind; simpl; try tauto; try (split; tauto).
  - split. tauto.
    destruct (atom_fresh AtomSetImpl.empty) as [x Hx].
    apply (proj2 (wf_open_var B 0 x)); auto.
  - split. tauto.
    destruct (atom_fresh AtomSetImpl.empty) as [x Hx].
    apply (proj2 (wf_open_var a 0 x)); auto.
  - tauto.
  - split. tauto.
    destruct (atom_fresh AtomSetImpl.empty) as [x Hx].
    apply (proj2 (wf_open_var B 0 x)); auto.
  - split; tauto.
  - tauto.
Qed.

Lemma lc_wf_iff : forall t, lc_tm t <-> wf 0 t.
Proof. intro t; split; [apply lc_wf | apply wf_lc]. Qed.
EOF

From Qual Require Import Qualitative_ott.
From mathcomp Require Import ssreflect ssrbool.
From Stdlib Require Import Lia.
Set Implicit Arguments.
Unset Strict Implicit.
Unset Printing Implicit Defensive.
Local Open Scope order_scope.
Local Close Scope bool_scope.

Fixpoint wf (k:nat) (t:tm) : Prop :=
  match t with
  | a_TyUnit => True
  | a_TmUnit => True
  | a_Pi _ A B => wf k A /\ wf (S k) B
  | a_Abs _ A b => wf k A /\ wf (S k) b
  | a_App a _ b => wf k a /\ wf k b
  | a_Type _ => True
  | a_Var_b n => n < k
  | a_Var_f _ => True
  | a_CEq _ a b _ A => wf k a /\ wf k b /\ wf k A
  | a_Refl => True
  | a_Transp a b => wf k a /\ wf k b
  | a_T _ A => wf k A
  | a_Box _ a => wf k a
  | a_Unbox _ a => wf k a
  | a_SSigma _ A B => wf k A /\ wf (S k) B
  | a_SPair a _ b => wf k a /\ wf k b
  | a_Proj1 _ a => wf k a
  | a_Proj2 _ a => wf k a
  | a_Bool => True
  | a_True => True
  | a_False => True
  | a_If a b0 b1 => wf k a /\ wf k b0 /\ wf k b1
  end.

(* replace index k of t by a variable *)
Lemma wf_open_var : forall t k x,
  wf (S k) t <-> wf k (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f x) t).
Proof.
  intros t. induction t; intros k vv; simpl.
  - tauto. - tauto.
  - rewrite (IHt1 k vv) (IHt2 (S k) vv); tauto.
  - rewrite (IHt1 k vv) (IHt2 (S k) vv); tauto.
  - rewrite (IHt1 k vv) (IHt2 k vv); tauto.
  - tauto.
  - destruct (lt_eq_lt_dec n k) as [[H|H]|H]; simpl; lia.
  - tauto.
  - rewrite (IHt1 k vv) (IHt2 k vv) (IHt3 k vv); tauto.
  - tauto.
  - rewrite (IHt1 k vv) (IHt2 k vv); tauto.
  - rewrite (IHt1 k vv); tauto.
  - rewrite (IHt1 k vv); tauto.
  - rewrite (IHt1 k vv); tauto.
  - rewrite (IHt1 k vv) (IHt2 (S k) vv); tauto.
  - rewrite (IHt1 k vv) (IHt2 k vv); tauto.
  - rewrite (IHt1 k vv); tauto.
  - rewrite (IHt1 k vv); tauto.
  - tauto. - tauto. - tauto.
  - rewrite (IHt1 k vv) (IHt2 k vv) (IHt3 k vv); tauto.
Qed.

Fixpoint tm_size (t:tm) : nat :=
  match t with
  | a_TyUnit | a_TmUnit | a_Type _ | a_Var_b _ | a_Var_f _ | a_Refl
  | a_Bool | a_True | a_False => 1
  | a_Pi _ A B => S (tm_size A + tm_size B)
  | a_Abs _ A b => S (tm_size A + tm_size b)
  | a_App a _ b => S (tm_size a + tm_size b)
  | a_CEq _ a b _ A => S (tm_size a + tm_size b + tm_size A)
  | a_Transp a b => S (tm_size a + tm_size b)
  | a_T _ A => S (tm_size A)
  | a_Box _ a => S (tm_size a)
  | a_Unbox _ a => S (tm_size a)
  | a_SSigma _ A B => S (tm_size A + tm_size B)
  | a_SPair a _ b => S (tm_size a + tm_size b)
  | a_Proj1 _ a => S (tm_size a)
  | a_Proj2 _ a => S (tm_size a)
  | a_If a b0 b1 => S (tm_size a + tm_size b0 + tm_size b1)
  end.

Lemma tm_size_open_var : forall t k x,
  tm_size (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f x) t) = tm_size t.
Proof.

  - reflexivity. - reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IHt1 k vv) (IHt2 (S k) vv); reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IHt1 k vv) (IHt2 (S k) vv); reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IHt1 k vv) (IHt2 k vv); reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - destruct (lt_eq_lt_dec n k); simpl; reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IHt1 k vv) (IHt2 k vv) (IHt3 k vv); reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IHt1 k vv) (IHt2 k vv); reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IHt1 k vv); reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IHt1 k vv); reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IHt1 k vv); reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IHt1 k vv) (IHt2 (S k) vv); reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IHt1 k vv) (IHt2 k vv); reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IHt1 k vv); reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IHt1 k vv); reflexivity.
  - reflexivity. - reflexivity. - reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IHt1 k vv) (IHt2 k vv) (IHt3 k vv); reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma wf_lc_aux : forall n t, tm_size t <= n -> wf 0 t -> lc_tm t.
Proof.

  - destruct t; simpl in Hle; lia.
  - destruct t; simpl in *.

    + (* App *) destruct Hwf as [Ha Hb]. constructor.
      * exact (IH _ ltac:(simpl in Hle; lia) Ha).
      * exact (IH _ ltac:(simpl in Hle; lia) Hb).
    + constructor.
    + (* Var_b impossible *) simpl in Hwf. lia.
    + constructor.
    + (* CEq *) destruct Hwf as [Ha [Hb Hc]]. econstructor.
      * exact (IH _ ltac:(simpl in Hle; lia) Ha).
      * exact (IH _ ltac:(simpl in Hle; lia) Hb).
      * exact (IH _ ltac:(simpl in Hle; lia) Hc).
    + constructor.
    + (* Transp *) destruct Hwf as [Ha Hb]. constructor; [exact (IH _ ltac:(simpl in Hle; lia) Ha)|exact (IH _ ltac:(simpl in Hle; lia) Hb)].
    + (* T *) destruct Hwf as [HA]. constructor. exact (IH _ ltac:(simpl in Hle; lia) HA).
    + (* Box *) destruct Hwf as [Ha]. constructor. exact (IH _ ltac:(simpl in Hle; lia) Ha).
    + (* Unbox *) destruct Hwf as [Ha]. constructor. exact (IH _ ltac:(simpl in Hle; lia) Ha).
    + (* SSigma *) destruct Hwf as [HA HB]. apply lc_a_SSigma; [ exact (IH _ ltac:(simpl; lia) HA) | ].
      intro x. apply (IH (open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x))).
      * rewrite tm_size_open_var. simpl in Hle. lia.
      * apply (proj1 (wf_open_var B 0 x)). exact HB.
    + (* SPair *) destruct Hwf as [Ha Hb]. constructor; [exact (IH _ ltac:(simpl in Hle; lia) Ha)|exact (IH _ ltac:(simpl in Hle; lia) Hb)].
    + (* Proj1 *) destruct Hwf as [Ha]. constructor. exact (IH _ ltac:(simpl in Hle; lia) Ha).
    + (* Proj2 *) destruct Hwf as [Ha]. constructor. exact (IH _ ltac:(simpl in Hle; lia) Ha).

Proof. intros t H. exact (wf_lc_aux (tm_size t) t (le_n _) H). Qed.

Lemma lc_wf : forall t, lc_tm t -> wf 0 t.

  - tauto.
Qed.

(* ============  Opening and substitution at the raw term level  ============ *)

Lemma open_rec_identity : forall t k, wf k t ->
  forall k' v, Nat.le k k' -> open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k' v t = t.
Proof.
  intros t. induction t as [| |psi A IHA Btx IHB|psi A IHA b IHb|a0 IHa psi b IHb
                 |s|n|xx|psi a0 IHa b IHb psi0 A IHA| |a0 IHa b IHb|psi A IHA
                 |psi a0 IHa|psi a0 IHa|psi A IHA Btx IHB|a0 IHa psi b IHb|psi a0 IHa
                 |psi a0 IHa| | | |a0 IHa b0 IHb0 b1 IHb1];
  intros k Hk k' v Hle; simpl.
  - reflexivity. - reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IHA k (proj1 Hk) k' v Hle).
    rewrite (IHB (S k) (proj2 Hk) (S k') v ltac:(lia)). reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IHA k (proj1 Hk) k' v Hle).
    rewrite (IHb (S k) (proj2 Hk) (S k') v ltac:(lia)). reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IHa k (proj1 Hk) k' v Hle).
    rewrite (IHb k (proj2 Hk) k' v Hle). reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - cbn [open_tm_wrt_tm_rec].
    destruct (lt_eq_lt_dec n k') as [[H|H]|H]; try reflexivity; exfalso; lia.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IHa k (proj1 Hk) k' v Hle).
    rewrite (IHb k (proj1 (proj2 Hk)) k' v Hle).
    rewrite (IHA k (proj2 (proj2 Hk)) k' v Hle). reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IHa k (proj1 Hk) k' v Hle).
    rewrite (IHb k (proj2 Hk) k' v Hle). reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IHA k Hk k' v Hle). reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IHa k Hk k' v Hle). reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IHa k Hk k' v Hle). reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IHA k (proj1 Hk) k' v Hle).
    rewrite (IHB (S k) (proj2 Hk) (S k') v ltac:(lia)). reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IHa k (proj1 Hk) k' v Hle).
    rewrite (IHb k (proj2 Hk) k' v Hle). reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IHa k Hk k' v Hle). reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IHa k Hk k' v Hle). reflexivity.
  - reflexivity. - reflexivity. - reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IHa k (proj1 Hk) k' v Hle).
    rewrite (IHb0 k (proj1 (proj2 Hk)) k' v Hle).
    rewrite (IHb1 k (proj2 (proj2 Hk)) k' v Hle). reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma lc_open_identity : forall t, lc_tm t -> forall k v, open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k v t = t.
Proof.
  intros t H k v. apply (open_rec_identity t 0). apply lc_wf, H. lia.
Qed.

Lemma wf_subst : forall t k, wf k t -> forall c x, wf 0 c -> wf k (subst_tm c x t).
Proof.
  intros t. induction t as [| |psi A IHA Btx IHB|psi A IHA b IHb|a0 IHa psi b IHb
                 |s|n|xx|psi a0 IHa b IHb psi0 A IHA| |a0 IHa b IHb|psi A IHA
                 |psi a0 IHa|psi a0 IHa|psi A IHA Btx IHB|a0 IHa psi b IHb|psi a0 IHa
                 |psi a0 IHa| | | |a0 IHa b0 IHb0 b1 IHb1];
  intros k Hk c y Hc; simpl.
  - exact I. - exact I.
  - split. exact (IHA k (proj1 Hk) c y Hc).
    exact (IHB (S k) (proj2 Hk) c y Hc).
  - split. exact (IHA k (proj1 Hk) c y Hc).
    exact (IHb (S k) (proj2 Hk) c y Hc).
  - split. exact (IHa k (proj1 Hk) c y Hc).
    exact (IHb k (proj2 Hk) c y Hc).
  - exact I.
  - exact Hk.
  - case: (eq_var xx y) => [E|NE].
    + exact (@wf_mono c 0 k (Nat.le_0_l k) Hc).
    + exact I.
  - split. exact (IHa k (proj1 Hk) c y Hc).
    split. exact (IHb k (proj1 (proj2 Hk)) c y Hc).
    exact (IHA k (proj2 (proj2 Hk)) c y Hc).
  - exact I.
  - split. exact (IHa k (proj1 Hk) c y Hc).
    exact (IHb k (proj2 Hk) c y Hc).
  - exact (IHA k Hk c y Hc).
  - exact (IHa k Hk c y Hc).
  - exact (IHa k Hk c y Hc).
  - split. exact (IHA k (proj1 Hk) c y Hc).
    exact (IHB (S k) (proj2 Hk) c y Hc).
  - split. exact (IHa k (proj1 Hk) c y Hc).
    exact (IHb k (proj2 Hk) c y Hc).
  - exact (IHa k Hk c y Hc).
  - exact (IHa k Hk c y Hc).
  - exact I. - exact I. - exact I.
  - split. exact (IHa k (proj1 Hk) c y Hc).
    split. exact (IHb0 k (proj1 (proj2 Hk)) c y Hc).
    exact (IHb1 k (proj2 (proj2 Hk)) c y Hc).
Qed.

Lemma lc_subst : forall t, lc_tm t -> forall c x, lc_tm c -> lc_tm (subst_tm c x t).
Proof.
  intros t Ht c x Hc. apply wf_lc. apply (@wf_subst t 0).
  - apply lc_wf, Ht.
  - apply lc_wf, Hc.
Qed.

Lemma subst_open_rec : forall t k u c x, lc_tm c ->
  subst_tm c x (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k u t)
  = open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k (subst_tm c x u) (subst_tm c x t).
Proof.
  intros t. induction t as [| |psi A IHA Btx IHB|psi A IHA b IHb|a0 IHa psi b IHb
                 |s|n|xx|psi a0 IHa b IHb psi0 A IHA| |a0 IHa b IHb|psi A IHA
                 |psi a0 IHa|psi a0 IHa|psi A IHA Btx IHB|a0 IHa psi b IHb|psi a0 IHa
                 |psi a0 IHa| | | |a0 IHa b0 IHb0 b1 IHb1];
  intros k u c y Hc; simpl.
  - reflexivity. - reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IHA k u c y Hc). rewrite (IHB (S k) u c y Hc). reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IHA k u c y Hc). rewrite (IHb (S k) u c y Hc). reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IHa k u c y Hc). rewrite (IHb k u c y Hc). reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - cbn [open_tm_wrt_tm_rec].
    destruct (lt_eq_lt_dec n k) as [[H|H]|H]; reflexivity.
  - case: (eq_var xx y) => [E|NE]; simpl.
    + rewrite (lc_open_identity c Hc k (subst_tm c y u)). reflexivity.
    + reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IHa k u c y Hc). rewrite (IHb k u c y Hc). rewrite (IHA k u c y Hc).
    reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IHa k u c y Hc). rewrite (IHb k u c y Hc). reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IHA k u c y Hc). reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IHa k u c y Hc). reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IHa k u c y Hc). reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IHA k u c y Hc). rewrite (IHB (S k) u c y Hc). reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IHa k u c y Hc). rewrite (IHb k u c y Hc). reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IHa k u c y Hc). reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IHa k u c y Hc). reflexivity.
  - reflexivity. - reflexivity. - reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IHa k u c y Hc). rewrite (IHb0 k u c y Hc). rewrite (IHb1 k u c y Hc).
    reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma subst_open : forall t u c x, lc_tm c ->
  subst_tm c x (open_tm_wrt_tm t u)
  = open_tm_wrt_tm (subst_tm c x t) (subst_tm c x u).
Proof. intros. unfold open_tm_wrt_tm. apply subst_open_rec. assumption. Qed.
EOF

Lemma notin_dom_insert : forall (P1 P2:econtext) (y:atom) (g:grade) (a:atom),
  a \notin dom (P1++P2) -> a <> y -> a \notin dom (P1 ++ (y,g)::P2).

  - apply notin_add_1 in H as Hb. apply notin_add_2 in H as Hd.
    apply notin_add_3; [ exact Hb | apply (IH P2 y g a); assumption ].

Lemma uniq_insert : forall (P1 P2:econtext) (y:atom) (g:grade),
  uniq (P1++P2) -> y \notin dom (P1++P2) -> uniq (P1 ++ (y,g)::P2).

cd /workspace; cat >> .work/found.v <<'EOF'

Scheme GDefEq_mutP := Induction for GDefEq Sort Prop
  with CGDefEq_mutP := Induction for CGDefEq Sort Prop.

Lemma gdefeq_insert : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a b:tm), GDefEq P psi a b ->
  forall (Q1 Q2:econtext) (yy:atom) (gg:grade), P = Q1++Q2 -> yy \notin dom P ->
    GDefEq (Q1++(yy,gg)::Q2) psi a b.
Proof.
  refine (@GDefEq_mutP
    (fun (e:econtext) (s:grade) (t t0:tm) (_:GDefEq e s t t0) =>
       forall (Q1 Q2:econtext) (yy:atom) (gg:grade), e = Q1++Q2 -> yy \notin dom e ->
         GDefEq (Q1++(yy,gg)::Q2) s t t0)
    (fun (e:econtext) (s s0:grade) (t t0:tm) (_:CGDefEq e s s0 t t0) =>
       forall (Q1 Q2:econtext) (yy:atom) (gg:grade), e = Q1++Q2 -> yy \notin dom e ->
         CGDefEq (Q1++(yy,gg)::Q2) s s0 t t0)
    _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _).
  - (* GE_Var *) intros P1 psi x psi0 u i bd Q1 Q2 yy gg Heq Hy. subst P1.
    apply GE_Var.
    + apply uniq_insert; assumption.
    + assumption.
    + apply binds_insert; assumption.
  - (* GE_Type *) intros P1 psi s u Q1 Q2 yy gg Heq Hy. subst P1.
    apply GE_Type. apply uniq_insert; assumption.
  - (* GE_Sym *) intros P1 psi bb aa gx IHx Q1 Q2 yy gg Heq Hy. subst P1.
    apply GE_Sym. apply (IHx Q1 Q2 yy gg eq_refl Hy).
  - (* GE_Trans *) intros P1 psi a b cc gx IHx gy IHy Q1 Q2 yy gg Heq Hy. subst P1.
    eapply GE_Trans.
    + apply (IHx Q1 Q2 yy gg eq_refl Hy).
    + apply (IHy Q1 Q2 yy gg eq_refl Hy).
  - (* GE_App *) intros P1 psi b0 psi0 a0 b1 a1 gx IHx cc IHc Q1 Q2 yy gg Heq Hy. subst P1.
    eapply GE_App.
    + apply (IHx Q1 Q2 yy gg eq_refl Hy).
    + apply (IHc Q1 Q2 yy gg eq_refl Hy).
  - (* GE_Abs *) intros L P1 psi psi0 A0 b0 A1 b1 l0 l1 gpt IHpt Q1 Q2 yy gg Heq Hy. subst P1.
    eapply (GE_Abs (L := L \u {{yy}})); [ exact l0 | exact l1 | ].
    intros z Hz.
    have HzL : z \notin L. { apply notin_union_1; exact Hz. }
    have Hzs : z \notin {{yy}}. { apply notin_union_2; exact Hz. }
    have Hyz : yy <> z. { apply notin_singleton_1; exact Hzs. }
    have Hzy : z <> yy. { intro E; apply Hyz; symmetry; exact E. }
    have Hfr : yy \notin dom ((z, psi0) :: (Q1++Q2)).
    { simpl. apply notin_add_3; [ exact Hzy | exact Hy ]. }
    apply (IHpt z HzL ((z,psi0)::Q1) Q2 yy gg ltac:(simpl; reflexivity) Hfr).
  - (* GE_Pi *) intros L P1 psi psi0 A0 B0 A1 B1 gd IHd gpt IHpt Q1 Q2 yy gg Heq Hy. subst P1.
    eapply (GE_Pi (L := L \u {{yy}})); [ | | ].
    + apply (IHd Q1 Q2 yy gg eq_refl Hy).
    + intros z Hz.
      have HzL : z \notin L. { apply notin_union_1; exact Hz. }
      have Hzs : z \notin {{yy}}. { apply notin_union_2; exact Hz. }
      have Hyz : yy <> z. { apply notin_singleton_1; exact Hzs. }
      have Hzy : z <> yy. { intro E; apply Hyz; symmetry; exact E. }
      have Hfr : yy \notin dom ((z, psi0) :: (Q1++Q2)).
      { simpl. apply notin_add_3; [ exact Hzy | exact Hy ]. }
      apply (IHpt z HzL ((z,psi0)::Q1) Q2 yy gg ltac:(simpl; reflexivity) Hfr).
  - (* GE_AppAbs *) intros P1 psi aa psi0 b0 a0 b1 A gx IHx cc IHc Q1 Q2 yy gg Heq Hy. subst P1.
    eapply GE_AppAbs.
    + apply (IHx Q1 Q2 yy gg eq_refl Hy).
    + apply (IHc Q1 Q2 yy gg eq_refl Hy).
  - (* GE_Refl *) intros P1 psi u Q1 Q2 yy gg Heq Hy. subst P1.
    apply GE_Refl. apply uniq_insert; assumption.
  - (* GE_Transp *) intros P1 psi a0 b0 a1 b1 gx IHx gy IHy Q1 Q2 yy gg Heq Hy. subst P1.
    eapply GE_Transp.
    + apply (IHx Q1 Q2 yy gg eq_refl Hy).
    + apply (IHy Q1 Q2 yy gg eq_refl Hy).
  - (* GE_CEq *) intros P1 psi psi0 a0 b0 psi1 A0 a1 b1 A1 l0 l1 gx IHx gy IHy hle Q1 Q2 yy gg Heq Hy. subst P1.
    eapply GE_CEq; [ exact l0 | exact l1 | | | exact hle ].
    + apply (IHx Q1 Q2 yy gg eq_refl Hy).
    + apply (IHy Q1 Q2 yy gg eq_refl Hy).
  - (* GE_TranspRefl *) intros P1 psi a0 b0 b1 gx IHx gy IHy Q1 Q2 yy gg Heq Hy. subst P1.
    eapply GE_TranspRefl.
    + apply (IHx Q1 Q2 yy gg eq_refl Hy).
    + apply (IHy Q1 Q2 yy gg eq_refl Hy).
  - (* GE_T *) intros P1 psi psi0 A B gx IHx Q1 Q2 yy gg Heq Hy. subst P1.
    eapply GE_T. apply (IHx Q1 Q2 yy gg eq_refl Hy).
  - (* GE_Box *) intros P1 psi psi0 a b cc IHc Q1 Q2 yy gg Heq Hy. subst P1.
    eapply GE_Box. apply (IHc Q1 Q2 yy gg eq_refl Hy).
  - (* GE_Unbox *) intros P1 psi psi0 a b gx IHx hle Q1 Q2 yy gg Heq Hy. subst P1.
    eapply GE_Unbox; [ apply (IHx Q1 Q2 yy gg eq_refl Hy) | exact hle ].
  - (* GE_UnboxBox *) intros P1 psi psi0 a b gx IHx hle Q1 Q2 yy gg Heq Hy. subst P1.
    eapply GE_UnboxBox; [ apply (IHx Q1 Q2 yy gg eq_refl Hy) | exact hle ].
  - (* GE_Proj1Cong *) intros P1 psi psi0 a0 a1 gx IHx hle Q1 Q2 yy gg Heq Hy. subst P1.
    eapply GE_Proj1Cong; [ apply (IHx Q1 Q2 yy gg eq_refl Hy) | exact hle ].
  - (* GE_Proj2Cong *) intros P1 psi psi0 a0 a1 gx IHx Q1 Q2 yy gg Heq Hy. subst P1.
    eapply GE_Proj2Cong; apply (IHx Q1 Q2 yy gg eq_refl Hy).
  - (* GE_Proj1Beta *) intros P1 psi psi0 b a1 a2 gx IHx hle Q1 Q2 yy gg Heq Hy. subst P1.
    eapply GE_Proj1Beta; [ apply (IHx Q1 Q2 yy gg eq_refl Hy) | exact hle ].
  - (* GE_Proj2Beta *) intros P1 psi psi0 b a2 a1 gx IHx Q1 Q2 yy gg Heq Hy. subst P1.
    eapply GE_Proj2Beta; apply (IHx Q1 Q2 yy gg eq_refl Hy).
  - (* GE_SPair *) intros P1 psi a0 psi0 b0 a1 b1 cc IHc gx IHx Q1 Q2 yy gg Heq Hy. subst P1.
    eapply GE_SPair.
    + apply (IHc Q1 Q2 yy gg eq_refl Hy).
    + apply (IHx Q1 Q2 yy gg eq_refl Hy).
  - (* GE_SSigma *) intros L P1 psi psi0 A0 B0 A1 B1 gd IHd gpt IHpt Q1 Q2 yy gg Heq Hy. subst P1.
    eapply (GE_SSigma (L := L \u {{yy}})); [ | | ].
    + apply (IHd Q1 Q2 yy gg eq_refl Hy).
    + intros z Hz.
      have HzL : z \notin L. { apply notin_union_1; exact Hz. }
      have Hzs : z \notin {{yy}}. { apply notin_union_2; exact Hz. }
      have Hyz : yy <> z. { apply notin_singleton_1; exact Hzs. }
      have Hzy : z <> yy. { intro E; apply Hyz; symmetry; exact E. }
      have Hfr : yy \notin dom ((z, psi0) :: (Q1++Q2)).
      { simpl. apply notin_add_3; [ exact Hzy | exact Hy ]. }
      apply (IHpt z HzL ((z,psi0)::Q1) Q2 yy gg ltac:(simpl; reflexivity) Hfr).
  - (* GE_TyUnit *) intros P1 psi u Q1 Q2 yy gg Heq Hy. subst P1. apply GE_TyUnit. apply uniq_insert; assumption.
  - (* GE_TmUnit *) intros P1 psi u Q1 Q2 yy gg Heq Hy. subst P1. apply GE_TmUnit. apply uniq_insert; assumption.
  - (* GE_Bool *) intros P1 psi u Q1 Q2 yy gg Heq Hy. subst P1. apply GE_Bool. apply uniq_insert; assumption.
  - (* GE_True *) intros P1 psi u Q1 Q2 yy gg Heq Hy. subst P1. apply GE_True. apply uniq_insert; assumption.
  - (* GE_False *) intros P1 psi u Q1 Q2 yy gg Heq Hy. subst P1. apply GE_False. apply uniq_insert; assumption.
  - (* GE_If *) intros P1 psi a0 b0 b1 a1 b2 b3 gx IHx gy IHy gz IHz Q1 Q2 yy gg Heq Hy. subst P1.
    eapply GE_If.
    + apply (IHx Q1 Q2 yy gg eq_refl Hy).
    + apply (IHy Q1 Q2 yy gg eq_refl Hy).
    + apply (IHz Q1 Q2 yy gg eq_refl Hy).
  - (* GE_IfTrue *) intros P1 psi a0 b0 b1 b2 b3 gx IHx gy IHy gz IHz Q1 Q2 yy gg Heq Hy. subst P1.
    eapply GE_IfTrue.
    + apply (IHx Q1 Q2 yy gg eq_refl Hy).
    + apply (IHy Q1 Q2 yy gg eq_refl Hy).
    + apply (IHz Q1 Q2 yy gg eq_refl Hy).
  - (* GE_IfFalse *) intros P1 psi a0 b0 b1 b3 b2 gx IHx gy IHy gz IHz Q1 Q2 yy gg Heq Hy. subst P1.
    eapply GE_IfFalse.
    + apply (IHx Q1 Q2 yy gg eq_refl Hy).
    + apply (IHy Q1 Q2 yy gg eq_refl Hy).
    + apply (IHz Q1 Q2 yy gg eq_refl Hy).
  - (* CGE_Leq *) intros P1 psi psi0 a b hle gx IHx Q1 Q2 yy gg Heq Hy. subst P1.
    eapply CGE_Leq; [ exact hle | apply (IHx Q1 Q2 yy gg eq_refl Hy) ].
  - (* CGE_NLeq *) intros P1 psi psi0 a b la lb hnle u Q1 Q2 yy gg Heq Hy. subst P1.
    eapply CGE_NLeq; [ exact la | exact lb | exact hnle | apply uniq_insert; assumption ].
Qed.
EOF

(* ============  Labels facts  ============ *)

Lemma labels_nil : labels nil = nil. Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma labels_cons : forall W x g A, labels ((x,(g,A))::W) = (x,g)::labels W.

(* uniq of labels from any typing derivation *)
Lemma uniq_labels_typing : forall W psi a A, Typing W psi a A -> uniq (labels W).
Proof.
  intros. apply uniq_labels. apply Ctx_uniq. apply typing_ctx. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma typing_gdefeq_refl : forall W psi a A, Typing W psi a A ->
  forall psi', psi <= psi' -> GDefEq (labels W) psi' a a.
Proof.
  intros W psi a A H. induction H; intros psi' Hle.
  - (* T_Type *) eapply GE_Type. apply uniq_labels. apply Ctx_uniq. assumption.
  - (* T_Var *) eapply (@GE_Var (labels W) psi' x psi0).
    + apply uniq_labels. apply Ctx_uniq. assumption.
    + exact (Order.POrderTheory.le_trans H0 Hle).
    + apply binds_labels. exact H1.
  - (* T_Pi *) eapply GE_Pi.
    + apply (IHTyping psi' Hle).
    + intros x Hx. apply (H1 x Hx psi' Hle).
  - (* T_Abs *)
    have HA : lc_tm A. { apply wf_lc. have HP := typing_wf H1. simpl in HP. exact (proj1 HP). }
    eapply GE_Abs; [ exact HA | exact HA | ].
    intros x Hx. apply (H0 x Hx psi' Hle).
  - (* T_App *) eapply GE_App.
    + apply (IHTyping1 psi' Hle).
    + case: (boolP (psi0 <= psi')) => [Hle0|Hnle0].
      * apply CGE_Leq; [ exact Hle0 | apply (IHTyping2 psi' Hle0) ].
      * apply CGE_NLeq; [ apply typing_lc; exact H0 | apply typing_lc; exact H0
                         | exact Hnle0 | apply uniq_labels_typing; exact H0 ].
  - (* T_Conv *) apply (IHTyping1 psi' Hle).
  - (* T_Refl *) eapply GE_Refl. apply uniq_labels_typing. exact H.
  - (* T_CEq *) eapply GE_CEq.
    + apply typing_lc; exact H1.
    + apply typing_lc; exact H1.
    + apply (IHTyping1 psi' Hle).
    + apply (IHTyping2 psi' Hle).
    + apply (Order.POrderTheory.le_trans (y := psi)); [ eassumption | exact Hle ].
  - (* T_Transp *) eapply GE_Transp.
    + apply (IHTyping1 psi' Hle).
    + apply (IHTyping2 psi' Hle).
  - (* T_T *) eapply GE_T. apply (IHTyping psi' Hle).
  - (* T_Box *)
    eapply GE_Box.
    case: (boolP (psi0 <= psi')) => [Hle0|Hnle0].
    + apply CGE_Leq; [ exact Hle0 | apply (IHTyping1 psi' Hle0) ].
    + apply CGE_NLeq; [ apply typing_lc; exact H | apply typing_lc; exact H
                       | exact Hnle0 | apply uniq_labels_typing; exact H0 ].
  - (* T_Unbox *) eapply GE_Unbox.
    + apply (IHTyping psi' Hle).
    + apply (Order.POrderTheory.le_trans (y := psi)); [ eassumption | exact Hle ].
  - (* T_SSigma *) eapply GE_SSigma.
    + apply (IHTyping psi' Hle).
    + intros x Hx. apply (H1 x Hx psi' Hle).
  - (* T_SPair *) eapply GE_SPair.
    + case: (boolP (psi0 <= psi')) => [Hle0|Hnle0].
      * apply CGE_Leq; [ exact Hle0 | apply (IHTyping2 psi' Hle0) ].
      * apply CGE_NLeq; [ apply typing_lc; exact H0 | apply typing_lc; exact H0
                         | exact Hnle0 | apply uniq_labels_typing; exact H0 ].
    + apply (IHTyping3 psi' Hle).
  - (* T_Proj1 *) eapply GE_Proj1Cong.
    + apply (IHTyping psi' Hle).
    + apply (Order.POrderTheory.le_trans (y := psi)); [ eassumption | exact Hle ].
  - (* T_Proj2 *) eapply GE_Proj2Cong. apply (IHTyping psi' Hle).
  - (* T_TyUnit *) eapply GE_TyUnit. apply uniq_labels. apply Ctx_uniq. assumption.
  - (* T_TmUnit *) eapply GE_TmUnit. apply uniq_labels_typing. exact H.
  - (* T_Bool *) eapply GE_Bool. apply uniq_labels. apply Ctx_uniq. assumption.
  - (* T_True *) eapply GE_True. apply uniq_labels_typing. exact H.
  - (* T_False *) eapply GE_False. apply uniq_labels_typing. exact H.
  - (* T_If *) eapply GE_If.
    + apply (IHTyping1 psi' Hle).
    + apply (IHTyping2 psi' Hle).
    + apply (IHTyping3 psi' Hle).
Qed.
EOF

cd /workspace; cat >> .work/found.v <<'EOF'

(* ============  Parallel reduction preserves headforms  ============ *)

Lemma par_headform : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a b:tm),
  Par P psi a b -> forall h, tm_to_headform a = Some h -> tm_to_headform b = Some h.
Proof.
  intros P psi a b H. induction H; intros h Hh; simpl in Hh;
    try discriminate Hh; try assumption.
Qed.

Lemma epar_headform : forall (P:econtext) (a b:tm),
  EPar P a b -> forall h, tm_to_headform a = Some h -> tm_to_headform b = Some h.
Proof.
  intros P a b H. induction H. apply par_headform with (psi:=psi); assumption.
Qed.

Lemma empar_headform : forall (P:econtext) (a b:tm),
  EMPar P a b -> forall h, tm_to_headform a = Some h -> tm_to_headform b = Some h.
Proof.
  intros P a b H. induction H; intros h Hh.
  - eapply epar_headform; eassumption.
  - eapply IHEMPar. eapply epar_headform; eassumption.
Qed.

Lemma ejoins_consistent : forall (P:econtext) (a b:tm),
  EJoins P a b ->
  forall h1 h2, tm_to_headform a = Some h1 -> tm_to_headform b = Some h2 -> h1 = h2.
Proof.
  intros P a b [c Hac Hbc] h1 h2 Ha Hb.
  assert (Hc1 : tm_to_headform c = Some h1) by (eapply empar_headform; eassumption).
  assert (Hc2 : tm_to_headform c = Some h2) by (eapply empar_headform; eassumption).
  rewrite Hc1 in Hc2. injection Hc2. auto.
Qed.
EOF

Inductive lc_tm : tm -> Prop :=

 | lc_a_TmUnit :
     (lc_tm a_TmUnit)

      ( forall x , lc_tm  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->

      ( forall x , lc_tm  ( open_tm_wrt_tm a (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     (lc_tm (a_Abs psi A a))
 | lc_a_App : forall (a:tm) (psi:grade) (b:tm),

     (lc_tm b) ->
     (lc_tm (a_App a psi b))
 | lc_a_Type : forall (s:sort),
     (lc_tm (a_Type s))
 | lc_a_Var_f : forall (x:tmvar),
     (lc_tm (a_Var_f x))
 | lc_a_CEq : forall (psi:grade) (a b:tm) (psi0:grade) (A:tm),
     (lc_tm a) ->
     (lc_tm b) ->
     (lc_tm A) ->
     (lc_tm (a_CEq psi a b psi0 A))
 | lc_a_Refl :
     (lc_tm a_Refl)
 | lc_a_Transp : forall (a b:tm),
     (lc_tm a) ->
     (lc_tm b) ->
     (lc_tm (a_Transp a b))
 | lc_a_T : forall (psi:grade) (A:tm),
     (lc_tm A) ->
     (lc_tm (a_T psi A))
 | lc_a_Box : forall (psi:grade) (a:tm),
     (lc_tm a) ->
     (lc_tm (a_Box psi a))
 | lc_a_Unbox : forall (psi:grade) (a:tm),
     (lc_tm a) ->
     (lc_tm (a_Unbox psi a))
 | lc_a_SSigma : forall (psi:grade) (A B:tm),
     (lc_tm A) ->
      ( forall x , lc_tm  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     (lc_tm (a_SSigma psi A B))
 | lc_a_SPair : forall (a:tm) (psi:grade) (b:tm),
     (lc_tm a) ->
     (lc_tm b) ->
     (lc_tm (a_SPair a psi b))
 | lc_a_Proj1 : forall (psi:grade) (a:tm),
